correctness.rationale: The marker count and counts of 02 and 12 fix the split and the Parikh vectors of both binary segments. The only free pair coordinate is 01; subtracting the cross term ad leaves the sum of the two internal coordinates. All exponents in each binary factor occur. When both degrees are positive every interior sum has at least two decompositions, and only the two aligned monotone endpoints can be singletons; when either degree is zero the other factor gives the binary singleton criterion, including empty segments. Binary coefficient-one terms are the entire factor when the smaller positive letter count is 1 and just 0, 1, ab−1, ab when both counts are at least 2, by Gaussian-binomial symmetry/unimodality and the two partitions of 2. Summing the disjoint mono/mono, mono/mixed, and mixed/mixed cases gives the stated rational series and cubic. An independent Python enumeration grouped every ternary word for n=1,…,10 by the three letter counts and the three unredundant mixed-pair counts; it matched the regular expression on every one-marker word and reproduced the first ten counts. The uploaded checker was inspected, not executed.
